name: PT Wulandari Bangun Laksana Tbk
summary: Operating within Indonesia's dynamic real estate sector, PT Wulandari Bangun Laksana Tbk specializes in developing and marketing a range of properties, including residential apartments, commercial shophouses, and condotels. The firm also provides business spaces for lease and manages various shopping centers. Founded in 1994, the company was originally named PT Dwi Pagria Lesatari, subsequently changing to its present identity, PT Wulandari Bangun Laksana Tbk, in April 2002. Its corporate base is situated in Balikpapan, Indonesia.
